working: The i gene has its own promoter and is expressed constitutively, so the repressor is always being made, which makes (1) correct. Lactose (as allolactose) inactivates the repressor rather than activating it, so (2) is wrong. The i gene has a separate promoter, so z, y and a do not share one promoter with i, and (3) is wrong. The inducer is lactose/allolactose, not galactose, so (4) is wrong.
